first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and has prior evidence of improving time-to-value and early adoption. I would verify that record and the strongest activation-messaging alternative before committing. Promotional pricing is deprioritized because its known 30-day retention harm conflicts with sustainable long-term qualified revenue. The experiment should track downstream qualified revenue and retention because prior onboarding evidence is strongest on early outcomes.

final.rationale: Run activation messaging because verified evidence shows a direct activation lift (+6%), stronger week-one engagement (+11%), and no observed retention tradeoff (+1% at 30 days). This directly addresses the 6% activation decline while aligning better with sustainable revenue than promotional pricing. Shortened onboarding is not selected because its verified 60-day churn increase in complex-workspace accounts creates material segmentation risk. Measure qualified conversion, retention, and expansion downstream because long-term revenue impact remains unproven.
